import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from icalendar import Calendar, Event
import pytz

TZ = pytz.timezone("America/New_York")
now = datetime.now(TZ)

# Compute "next Wednesday" strictly after today (Wednesday = weekday index 2)
days_ahead = (2 - now.weekday()) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
wed = now.date() + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

# 3 PM for one hour, in the event's local timezone
dtstart = TZ.localize(datetime(wed.year, wed.month, wed.day, 15, 0, 0))
dtend = dtstart + timedelta(hours=1)

cal = Calendar()
cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN")
cal.add("version", "2.0")

event = Event()
event.add("summary", "Team Meeting")
event.add("description", "Weekly team meeting")
event.add("dtstart", dtstart)
event.add("dtend", dtend)
event.add("dtstamp", datetime.now(pytz.UTC))
event.add("uid", f"{uuid.uuid4()}@example.com")
event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
event.add("sequence", 0)

cal.add_component(event)

with open("team_meeting.ics", "wb") as f:
    f.write(cal.to_ical())

# Validate by re-parsing the written file
with open("team_meeting.ics", "rb") as f:
    parsed = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())

for comp in parsed.walk():
    if comp.name == "VEVENT":
        print("SUMMARY:", comp.get("summary"))
        print("UID:", comp.get("uid"))
        print("DTSTART:", comp.get("dtstart").dt)
        print("DTEND:", comp.get("dtend").dt)
        print("STATUS:", comp.get("status"))

print("ICS file written and validated: team_meeting.ics")

import uuid
import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

# --- Date computation (standard library only) ---
TZ_NAME = "America/New_York"
# Offset for America/New_York (EDT, UTC-4 during summer) - used only for display sanity check
TZ_OFFSET = timedelta(hours=-4)

now_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_local = now_utc + TZ_OFFSET

# "Next Wednesday" strictly after today (Wednesday = weekday index 2)
days_ahead = (2 - now_local.weekday()) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
wed = now_local.date() + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

# --- Build ICS content ---
def ics_dt(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@example.com"
dtstamp = now_utc.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
dtstart_local = datetime(wed.year, wed.month, wed.day, 15, 0, 0)
dtend_local = dtstart_local + timedelta(hours=1)

lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
    f"DTSTART;TZID={TZ_NAME}:{ics_dt(dtstart_local)}",
    f"DTEND;TZID={TZ_NAME}:{ics_dt(dtend_local)}",
    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Weekly team meeting",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]
ics_content = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"

with open("team_meeting.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(ics_content)

# --- Validate the written file ---
with open("team_meeting.ics", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    content = f.read()

assert content.startswith("BEGIN:VCALENDAR"), "Missing calendar start"
assert "END:VCALENDAR" in content, "Missing calendar end"
assert "BEGIN:VEVENT" in content and "END:VEVENT" in content, "Missing VEVENT block"
assert "VERSION:2.0" in content, "Missing VERSION"

required = ["UID:", "DTSTAMP:", "DTSTART;TZID=", "DTEND;TZID=", "SUMMARY:"]
for field in required:
    assert field in content, f"Missing required field {field}"

# Verify DTSTAMP is UTC (ends with Z)
dtstamp_match = re.search(r"DTSTAMP:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)", content)
assert dtstamp_match, "DTSTAMP must be in UTC format"

# Verify DTSTART/DTEND are valid local times and DTEND > DTSTART
start_match = re.search(r"DTSTART;TZID=.*?:(\d{8}T\d{6})", content)
end_match = re.search(r"DTEND;TZID=.*?:(\d{8}T\d{6})", content)
assert start_match and end_match, "DTSTART/DTEND format invalid"
start_dt = datetime.strptime(start_match.group(1), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
end_dt = datetime.strptime(end_match.group(1), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
assert end_dt > start_dt, "DTEND must be after DTSTART"

print("Event date (next Wednesday):", wed.isoformat())
print("DTSTART (America/New_York):", start_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"))
print("DTEND   (America/New_York):", end_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"))
print("Duration: 1 hour")
print("UID:", uid)
print("ICS file written and validated: team_meeting.ics")
